title: Research: dirty-shadow sym-diff collapse at eight queries (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Answers open question 2 of [#2761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2761) and the matching handoff in [#2764](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2764) in the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898): does the dirty-shadow sym-diff collapse extend verbatim to eight queries?

| Alphabet | Distinct-7 min R | One-dup min R | Tariff at X=0 | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Even-subset (#2677) | 74 | 82 | 452 | no |
| Dirty shadow (legal) | **74** | **82** | **452** | **no** |
| Clean shadow (illegal) | **67** | **71** | **438** | **no** (still ≥436) |

Dirty shadow collapses to even-subset by sym-diff with the snapshot index on every covering distinct-7 list and every covering one-duplicate multiset. A dirt-free shadow would reach `R=67` (tariff `438`) but still fails to undercut `436` at `X=0` and remains illegal under PR1898 inherited dirt.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2836](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2836) / [#2817](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2817) / [#2764](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2764) / [#2761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2761) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/dirty-shadow-8q-obstruction/`.
Tip: `ad644b1eff88e7ee2ca0ee6d5561fafb439bb369`.

Exact: legal dirty-shadow min R **74** (tariff **452**); illegal clean-shadow min R **67** (tariff **438**); no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/dirty-shadow-8q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/dirty-shadow-8q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/dirty-shadow-8q-obstruction/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/dirty-shadow-8q-obstruction/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dirty-shadow-8q-obstruction
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_DIRTY_SHADOW_8Q_OBSTRUCTION dirty_shadow_min_R=74 ... answers_mc7q_oq2 matches_2677_even_floor no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_DIRTY_SHADOW_8Q covering=2430400 one_dup=4083072 dirty_min=74 ... answers_mc7q_oq2 no_new_kappa
PASS_DIRTY_SHADOW_8Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/dirty-shadow-8q-obstruction outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2761) (dirty-shadow at Q=7; OQ2), [#2764](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2764), [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677). Freestanding Q=8 dirty-shadow fixture; no competing open PR at refresh.
